responseText:
Now that's the kind of follow through I like to see. Good work. Clean, sturdy materials, just what we needed. You've earned your keep, and then some.

Hope by now you've made friends with that Ram. It may not much to look at, but they're reliable and surefooted beasts. Should make the hauling a bit less backbreaking. Keep at it and Hammer Rest just might stand a chance.
